title: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro Fold Is Better, but Not the Best
summary: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold doesn’t look different from the 10 Pro Fold , but Google has shaved off a fraction of a millimeter and 19 grams. I’m not convinced the 11 Pro Fold earns the “Pro” in its title.
